message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 in Europeans**

| Allele | Frequency (European populations) |
|--------|----------------------------------|
| **C** (minor allele) | ~0.12 (≈ 12 %) |
| **T** (major allele) | ~0.88 (≈ 88 %) |

*The C allele at rs7412 is the defining allele of the APOE ε2 isoform. Frequencies are taken from large-scale population databases such as the 1000 Genomes Project and gnomAD, which report a minor‑allele frequency of ~12 % in individuals of European ancestry.*

> **Note:** Frequencies can vary slightly among sub‑populations (e.g., Northern vs. Southern Europeans), but the overall European minor‑allele frequency remains around 10–13 %.
